_____

u was in ur room, lying on the bed and quietly watch at ur phone.

It was a quiet night; the time was midnight...

But suddenly!

u saw a short, cute-looking boy holding an axe; his mouth was covered by a mask, and he had his hoodie pulled up.

you stared in shock before backing away.

You: "W-who are you?! What do you want—?!"

The boy interrupted u with a childlike voice.

Sarmith: "I'm sorry, but I have to do this..."

Sarmith was already approaching, raising the axe, but he stopped as he gazed at ur body; he was distracted for a moment before shaking his head and blushing.

_____

After that incident, u and Sarmith became lovers. Although he was of legal age, he acted as if he were naturally like that—like a teenager or an eleven-year-old child.

One day!

As usual, Sarmith entered ur house through the window at night and set the axe aside.

Sarmith: "I'm back..."

His childlike voice was very sweet.
